title: Seal (container seal, blob <container>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/seal-<n>.json, put-once)
description: Unsigned, hash-chained stamp of every blob version in <container> not in an earlier seal. A stamp, not an attestation: it does not establish authenticity.

sealer.description: as asserted by the sealer's token (receipt writer shape)

previous_seal.description: null for seal 1; otherwise the previous seal's blob name and the sha256 of its stored bytes

sha256_actual.description: the sealer's own rehash of the stored bytes

sha256_receipt.description: objects only: sha256 named by the receipt

receipt_sha256.description: objects only: sha256 of the receipt's stored bytes (binds the receipt)

entries_sha256.description: sha256 of the Python client's canonical JSON of entries (json.dumps(indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + newline, UTF-8)
